tagline.en: Charlotte's outer loop, closed after a quarter-century
tagline.zh: 夏洛特外环：四分之一世纪后才合圈

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026

en: I-485 is a complete circle around Charlotte, North Carolina — the only place in the country the number is used. The FHWA route log counts 65.62 miles of Interstate mileage; NCDOT describes the finished road as a 67-mile loop. It is an even hundreds number off I-85 and it behaves like one, leaving I-85 on the north-east side of the city and coming back to it on the west.

Charlotte grew hard through the years the loop was being built, and the beltway both followed and drove that growth: the southern quadrant through Ballantyne and Matthews was four lanes when it opened and needed widening to six almost immediately. Since 2019 the state has been adding a tolled express lane in each direction between the I-77 interchange and the Monroe Expressway, the busiest part of the ring, with opening expected in early 2026 after repeated delays.
zh: I-485 是围绕北卡罗来纳州夏洛特的一整圈环线，这个编号在全美仅此一处使用。联邦公路管理局的路线名录记 65.62 英里州际里程；北卡州交通部则把建成后的这条路称作 67 英里的环线。它是从 I-85 分出的偶数百位编号，行为也名副其实：在城市东北侧离开 I-85，又在西侧回到 I-85。
环线建设的这些年里夏洛特扩张剧烈，而这条环线既是跟随者也是推动者：穿过巴兰坦与马修斯的南象限通车时只有四车道，几乎立刻就需要拓宽到六车道。自 2019 年起，该州在 I-77 枢纽与门罗快速路之间——环线上最繁忙的一段——每向增建一条收费快速车道；在多次延期后，预计 2026 年初开通。

en: The loop was built quadrant by quadrant over roughly twenty-five years, which is why there is no single construction figure for it. Individual segments give the shape of the spending: 7.5 miles between NC 24-27 and NC 49, joining I-85 to the university area, cost $55.4 million and opened on 3 September 2003 after two and a half years' work.

The last piece was the north-east: 5.7 miles of eight-lane freeway from west of NC 115 to east of I-85, linking I-77 to I-85 and closing the ring. NCDOT let it as a design-build-finance contract with a construction value of $139.5 million, and the design-builder agreed to a payment schedule stretched over five and a half years against four and a half years of construction. Including right of way and the associated interchange work the segment came to about $231.7 million. It opened at a ribbon-cutting on 5 June 2015.
zh: 这条环线在约二十五年间按象限分块建成，因此没有单一的总造价数字。各分段能勾出支出的轮廓：NC 24-27 与 NC 49 之间的 7.5 英里，把 I-85 接到大学城一带，造价 5,540 万美元，历时两年半，于 2003 年 9 月 3 日通车。
最后一块在东北：自 NC 115 以西至 I-85 以东的 5.7 英里八车道高速，把 I-77 接上 I-85，完成合圈。北卡州交通部以「设计－建造－融资」合同发包，建设合同额 1.395 亿美元；承包方同意在四年半的施工期之上，接受长达五年半的分期付款安排。连同征地与相关立交工程，该段总额约 2.317 亿美元。它于 2015 年 6 月 5 日剪彩通车。

value.en: 65.62 miles of Interstate mileage in North Carolina; NCDOT calls it a 67-mile loop
value.zh: 北卡罗来纳州境内州际里程 65.62 英里；北卡州交通部称之为 67 英里环线

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026, and NCDOT Charlotte Outer Loop project page

value.zh: 5.7 英里，建设合同 1.395 亿美元，全部计入约 2.317 亿美元，2015 年 6 月 5 日通车

figures.source: FHWA Center for Innovative Finance Support project profile, I-485 Charlotte Loop, and WCNC, 5 June 2015

timeline.en: A 7.5-mile north-eastern segment opens on 3 September, linking I-85 to the university area.
timeline.zh: 东北 7.5 英里路段于 9 月 3 日通车，连接 I-85 与大学城一带。

timeline.en: Construction starts on the last 5.7 miles between NC 115 and I-85.
timeline.zh: NC 115 与 I-85 之间最后 5.7 英里开工。

timeline.en: The loop is completed on 5 June, about two decades after work first began.
timeline.zh: 环线于 6 月 5 日建成，距最初动工约二十年。

timeline.en: Work begins on tolled express lanes between I-77 and the Monroe Expressway.
timeline.zh: I-77 与门罗快速路之间的收费快速车道开工。
